mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS uningested, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.status != 4 AND d.content_version = i.live_file_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ingested, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.status != 4 AND d.content_version != i.live_file_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS stale, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS invalid FROM knowledge_article_index i LEFT JOIN knowledge_doc d ON d.source = 1 AND d.source_id = i.article_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0
SELECT article_id FROM knowledge_article_index WHERE deleted = 0
